answers.rationale: The requirement specifies a modification to the number of 15kV vacuum circuit breaker positions in a switchgear lineup. The CROWN-ARMV product is a metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear lineup with vacuum circuit breakers, which matches the described requirement. The modification to the number of breaker positions indicates an engineered-to-order (ETO) offering.

The requirement specifies seismic qualification for a switchgear lineup. The CROWN-ARMV product, being a medium-voltage switchgear lineup, is the appropriate product to meet this requirement. Seismic qualification is typically part of an engineered-to-order (ETO) offering.

This requirement pertains to a warranty clause, which is a commercial term and not a product-specific technical requirement. Therefore, it is not associated with any specific product or business unit.
